notes: A. James Clark School of Engineering official Fall 2026 Computer Engineering graduation plan. General-education slots (ENGL101, Oral Communication, Professional Writing, Scholarship in Practice, Humanities, History/Social Sciences) are left out: only the program's own requirements are audited here (they're covered by gen-ed-2026-27.ts). ENEE200 (Engineering Ethics) stays: the plan prints it in its Major Requirements column even though it also satisfies a Humanities/Big-Question gen-ed slot.
Chemistry is filled with CHEM135 alone (the option printed first on the plan's overview page), not the CHEM131+CHEM134 alternate.
The 'ENEE304 or ENEE322', 'ENEE324 or STAT400' and 'CMSC412 or ENEE447' choices are each filled with the option printed first on the plan.

The generic Technical Elective slots (Category A x2, B, C x2, D, E, F, and the Additional elective, totaling 26 credits) are filled with: Category A = MATH401, MATH402; Category B = CMSC420; Category C = ENEE420, ENEE425; Category D = ENEE445; Category E = CMSC435; Category F = MATH403; Additional = ENEE460. Any courses meeting each category's own minimum credits would satisfy the requirement equally.
